notes.title: Initial words
notes.content: Hello, puzzle enthusiasts! I'm excited to introduce you to LabSorter, a game that will put your logic skills to the test. We're in the final stages of development, and soon you'll be able to dive into the exciting world of sorting. In the meantime, we're preparing a demo version for you to experience the game's atmosphere firsthand. Join our community to learn more about the release date and share your expectations!
